Want your days entirely to yourself? Whether you're studying, working out, or just love chilling in the afternoon, we've got the perfect setup for you. Step into the night shift as a warehouse worker and earn up to a massive € 22.49 per hour! Work while the city sleeps and enjoy the ultimate daytime freedom. Keep reading or apply in a flash!

What we offer
- A solid base rate of € 14.99 per hour 💰
- A massive 50% night premium
(€ 22.49 an hour!)🌙
- Working the peaceful, traffic-free night shifts 🦉
- Weekly payment 💸
- A chance to score a fixed contract in  12 weeks 🤝
- Travel expenses covered at € 0.23 per kilometer!🚗

Who you are
We are looking for motivated team players who know how to hustle. If you bring the energy and the right attitude, we’ll provide the great pay! Let's see if we are a match:

- 🎂 You are at least 18 years old
- 💪 You’re physically fit and love doing active, hands-on work
- 🗓️ You’re available to work the night shifts (between 01.00 and 10.00)
- 🚗 You have your own transport to get to the depot in Zwolle (since public transport can be tricky at night!)
- 🗣️ You can speak English or Dutch

What will you do
Ever wonder how a package gets delivered so incredibly fast? It’s because of you! As part of the night team, you ensure thousands of parcels are processed and ready for their final journey before the sun comes up. Here is a sneak peek into your shift:

- 🚛 Tackling the heavy lifting by loading and unloading trailers;
- 🎯 Scanning and sorting goods precisely to the right delivery routes;
- 🚀 Moving roll containers around the warehouse floor and staging orders;
- ✨ Teaming up to keep the depot tidy and safe.

Where will you work
You will be joining DPD, one of the biggest names in logistics worldwide! From our bustling depot in Zwolle, you’ll be working alongside a super friendly, international team where everyone looks out for each other. Good music on, high energy on the floor, and a great vibe all around—it’s the ideal envir

In this role, you will be part of a close-knit and hardworking team. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that all tasks are carried out as efficiently as possible so that the workday can be completed together.

As a Supply Chain Order Picker, you will work with your own picking trolley equipped with crates in which you collect customer orders. Once the crates are filled, you will place them on a conveyor belt, where they are automatically transported to the next department. You will use a handheld scanner in combination with a voice-picking system. For this position, it’s important that you have basic computer skills, as you will also need to process certain warehouse tasks in the system. During a comprehensive training session on your first working day, you will learn how to use this system.

Most of your work will take place in the warehouse, where you will collect products. Some of these products are stored in refrigerated or freezer areas. You will be provided with a warm jacket for working in these areas. After collecting the required products, you will return to the main warehouse.

The working days are Monday to Friday. (shift starts between 08:00 a.m. and 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 or 04:30 p.m.)

- Minimum of vmbo-level work and thinking skills
- One to two years of experience in a similar role
- Good command of the English language
- Willingness to work in a team and be flexible with shifts
- Experience with order picking and voice-picking systems is a plus

As a warehouse employee logistics, you are indispensable in the logistics process. You work full-time day shifts from 06:30 to 15:15 and make sure everything runs smoothly. In this role, you have lots of freedom to suggest improvements and plenty of opportunities to grow. You work with modern equipment and follow training to obtain or renew your certificates. The position is structural, so there’s a chance for a permanent contract if it’s a fit for both sides.

You start your working day by receiving and checking goods. Then you pick orders, prepare materials for production, and keep the warehouse tidy. You operate the reach truck and stacker and process incoming and outgoing goods with a handheld scanner. In between, you discuss process improvements with colleagues or help pack production orders.

Are you ready for an active job as a warehouse employee logistics in Eindhoven? Apply quickly and experience the benefits of a great workplace where you can develop yourself!

- 

- Mbo working and thinking level, experience in logistics is a plus

- Certificate for reach truck and stacker or willing to obtain these

- Basic computer skills, preferably experience with Excel or SAP

- You speak good English, Dutch is a plus

- Structured, accurate and proactive, flexible availability

This job is perfect for anyone who wants to assemble and build high-quality machines, and get a salary of up to €3,800 per month and a direct contract with our client in Hengelo in return. Are you the assembly technician we are looking for? Keep reading to find out!

Your tasks as high-tech assembly technician include: 

    - Assembling and installing mechanical components and complete systems
    
- Performing precision mechanical and electrical assembly work
    
- Working from technical drawings, work instructions and specifications
    
- Carrying out quality inspections and verifying dimensions and tolerances
    
- Identifying deviations and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives
    
- Supporting testing, adjustment and commissioning activities

What's in it for you?

Gross salary of between €3,200 and €3,800 per month

Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer

Full-time job of 40 hours per week

Direct contract with our client

Your education level and working experience:

    - At least an mbo level of education or a comparable technical background, preferably in a technical field
    
- Proven experience in an assembly role within a technical production environment
    
- Hands-on experience with precision mechanical and electrical assembly work

Additionally, you have:

    - The ability to accurately read and follow technical drawings, work instructions and specifications
    
- A good command of the English language, both spoken and written, as English is the primary working language within the organization
    
- Knowledge of Dutch is considered an advantage but is not required
    
- A detail-oriented mindset with a strong focus on quality, safety and delivering high-standard work.

Can’t wait to start your new job? Apply today! A Manpower colleague will contact you as soon as possible!

The end times are flexible. Sometimes you work on Saturdays. On that day there is only a morning shift. Action works with a clock pass. In addition, it is mandatory to wear work shoes as a Reachtruck driver at Action.
